name: Shapeshifter
summary: A feral Ranger who assumes chosen animal aspects, combines two forms, and masters true bestial transformations.

features.name: Shifter's Blessing 1
features.summary: Choose a permanent animal aspect and assume it as a swift action.
features.uses: 1/day for Ranger level + Wisdom modifier rounds

features.name: Shifter's Blessing 2
features.summary: Choose a second animal aspect and gain another daily use.

features.name: Shifter's Blessing 3
features.summary: Choose a third animal aspect and gain another daily use.

features.name: Shifter's Blessing 4
features.summary: Choose a fourth animal aspect and gain another daily use.

features.name: Dual Form Shifter
features.summary: Assume two selected Shifter's Blessing forms at once and gain both sets of benefits.

features.name: Master Shifter
features.summary: Improve every selected form and optionally assume its true beast or dragon shape while retaining Dual Form Shifter.
